sahneler.metin: Near Singapore, the destroyer John S. McCain collided with an oil tanker.
Flooding hit crew berthing, and ten sailors died.
The crew believed they'd lost steering.
Control had been shifted between stations.
The touchscreen controls were overly complex.
Sailors weren't sure where key indicators were.
Reports also cited fatigue and poor communication.
The Navy moved back toward physical controls.

aciklama:
USS John S. McCain collided with a tanker near Singapore. The cause: overly complex touchscreen controls and a fatigued crew mishandling a steering transfer.
